title: Umbrella Wing
description: Camouflaged against the bark of a tree, a tawny frogmouth (Podargus strigoides) stretches its wings covering two other birds from the forest rain in Perth, Australia. The bird's big eyes and bright yellow insides of its mouth is meant to frighten predators and potentially attract prey.
translated_description: 在澳大利亚珀斯，一只茶色蟆口鸱（学名：Podargus strigoides）伪装在树皮上，展开翅膀为另外两只鸟遮挡林中的雨水。这种鸟的大眼睛和嘴内明亮的黄色旨在吓退捕食者，也可能吸引猎物。
